component.name: BrightPanel
component.summary: Production-grade external monitor control suite for Fedora Linux

description.p: BrightPanel gives Linux users seamless hardware control over external monitors connected via HDMI, DisplayPort, or USB-C using DDC/CI protocol.

ul.li: Direct hardware brightness, contrast, audio volume, and input source switching.
GNOME Shell Top Panel integration with quick sliders.
Thread-safe rate limiting and debouncing to prevent I2C bus lockup.
Automated Fedora system diagnostics and permission configuration.

description.p: Initial production release of BrightPanel for Fedora Linux.
